# 金山词霸 (Kingsoft Dictionary)

> > 金山词霸 is a comprehensive AI-powered online translation and vocabulary learning platform supporting 177 languages with multi-format support and exam preparation tools.

金山词霸 (also known as 爱词霸) is Kingsoft's flagship translation and dictionary service, offering integrated translation, word lookup, and vocabulary learning across multiple platforms. The platform combines traditional dictionary references with modern AI-powered translation and writing assistance features.

## Key Topics

- AI翻译 (AI Translation)
- 在线翻译 (Online Translation)
- 词典 (Dictionary)
- 爱词霸 (iCIBA)
- 金山词霸 (Kingsoft Dictionary)
- 语音翻译 (Voice Translation)
- 文档翻译 (Document Translation)
- 图片翻译 (Image Translation)
- 词汇学习 (Vocabulary Learning)
- 网页翻译 (Web Translation)
- AI对话 (AI Conversation)
- 柯林斯词典 (Collins Dictionary)
- 牛津词典 (Oxford Dictionary)
- 多平台支持 (Multi-platform Support)
- 考试备考 (Exam Preparation)

## Translation Services

- [金山词霸 - Main Translation Platform](https://www.iciba.com): Kingsoft's 金山词霸 main translation platform supporting 177 languages with AI-powered features for text, image, and document translation
- [Dedicated Translation Subdomain](https://translate.iciba.com): Dedicated translation subdomain for text, image and document translation with AI support

## Dictionary & Word Reference

- [Dictionary Entry - 在线翻译](https://www.iciba.com/word): Dictionary reference entry with definitions, pronunciation, usage examples, and translation for '在线翻译' (online translation)
- [Dictionary Entry - HTTP Mirror](http://www.iciba.com/word): HTTP mirror of dictionary entry with pronunciation guide and usage examples

## Vocabulary Learning

- [爱词吧 - Vocabulary Learning Platform](https://word.iciba.com): 爱词吧 vocabulary learning platform with exam preparation for CET-4/6, TOEFL, GRE, IELTS and comprehensive English word lists
